result.description:
Title: OutSystems Developer / Consultant
Company: KRE8 IT Pty Ltd
Location: Narre Warren / Melbourne based preferred, with the option to work remotely within Australia. Applicants must be based in Australia due to the regulatory requirements of some of our clients.
Salary: $110,000 - $140,000 per annum, depending on relevant experience
Employment type: Full-time

About KRE8 IT
KRE8 IT is a Melbourne-based technology consulting company specialising in practical software delivery, low-code development, systems integration, and digital transformation. We work with clients to design, build, and support business-critical applications, with a strong focus on governed delivery, maintainable architecture, and high-quality outcomes.
We are seeking an OutSystems Developer / Consultant to support the design, development, implementation, and ongoing improvement of OutSystems applications for our clients.

About the role
The OutSystems Developer / Consultant will work across the full delivery lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, application development, integration, testing, deployment support, and continuous improvement. The role requires strong hands-on OutSystems development capability as well as the ability to work in a consulting environment with clients and internal delivery teams.

Key responsibilities
*   Design, develop, test, and maintain applications using OutSystems.
*   Work with both OutSystems O11 and OutSystems Developer Cloud environments.
*   Translate business requirements into reliable, maintainable application solutions.
*   Develop integrations with external systems, APIs, data services, and business platforms.
*   Support implementation of complex business workflows, decision logic, and rules-driven functionality.
*   Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, designers, analysts, and other developers to deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
*   Contribute to application architecture, technical design, estimation, documentation, and delivery planning.
*   Troubleshoot, optimise, and improve existing OutSystems applications.
*   Support quality assurance, deployment activities, and production support where required.
*   Apply secure, scalable, and maintainable development practices.

Required experience, qualifications, and skills
*   Minimum 1 year of experience developing applications with OutSystems, including both O11 and ODC.
*   A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field is required. Where the qualification is not directly relevant to the position, the applicant must demonstrate a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience.
*   Must be based in Australia and able to work with clients operating under Australian regulatory requirements.
*   Strong software development experience, including application design, data modelling, integration, testing, and debugging.
*   Experience working in consulting, client delivery, or project-based software delivery environments.
*   Ability to analyse business requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
*   Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
*   Ability to work independently and manage delivery responsibilities with attention to quality and detail.

Highly regarded
*   Demonstrated experience implementing complex decision logic using business rules management systems.
*   Experience implementing applications in the healthcare industry.
*   Working understanding of the FHIR interoperability standard.
*   Experience with API integration, workflow automation, data exchange, and enterprise application integration.
*   Relevant OutSystems certifications.

How to apply
Please apply through this job advertisement platform with your resume and a short cover note outlining your relevant OutSystems experience, including your experience with O11 and ODC.

Location: Kununurra, Western Australia (East Kimberley)
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing (38 hours per week)

About Us

Coral Coast Distributors (Cairns) Pty Ltd is a privately owned retail and distribution business supplying household goods and everyday essentials throughout the East Kimberley region of Western Australia.

We operate retail stores that service regional and remote communities, with a strong focus on customer service, operational excellence and community engagement. We value teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement, and offer stable, long-term employment opportunities within a growing regional business.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Retail Supervisor to oversee the day-to-day operations of our retail store in Kununurra.

This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for supervising staff, coordinating daily store operations, maintaining merchandising and presentation standards, managing stock and cash handling processes, and delivering exceptional customer service.

The successful applicant will be capable of working independently, leading by example and contributing to the continued success of our regional retail operations.

Salary: $69,000 per annum plus superannuation.

Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities
Supervise the day-to-day operation of the retail store in accordance with company policies and procedures.
Lead, coach and support Retail Assistants to achieve high standards of customer service and operational performance.
Coordinate staff rosters and assist with onboarding and training of new employees.
Deliver exceptional customer service and resolve customer enquiries and complaints professionally.
Process retail sales using POS and EFTPOS systems.
Complete daily cash reconciliation, banking and cash handling procedures.
Receive, check and organise incoming stock deliveries.
Maintain stock levels, conduct stocktakes and monitor inventory accuracy.
Ensure visual merchandising and store presentation standards are maintained.
Maintain a clean, safe and well-organised workplace.
Process customer returns and refunds in accordance with company procedures.
Complete store reporting, administrative tasks and timesheets accurately and on time.
Use POS, inventory management and Microsoft Office software to support store operations.
Skills and Experience
Minimum two years' experience in a retail supervisory or retail management position.
Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate staff within a retail environment.
Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
Experience with cash handling, banking and reconciliation procedures.
Sound computer skills, including Microsoft Office and POS systems.
Strong organisational and time-management skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to communicate effectively with customers, colleagues and management.
Willingness to work a rotating roster, including weekends where required.
Commitment to working respectfully with people from diverse cultural backgrounds.
Willingness to live and work in Kununurra, a regional location in the East Kimberley.
Desirable
Experience working in regional or remote retail environments.
Experience using inventory management and stock control systems.
Current First Aid Certificate (desirable but not essential).
Pre-Employment Requirements
National Police Check (acceptable outcome).
Valid right to work in Australia, or willingness to participate in an employer-sponsored visa program where eligible.
How to Apply

Please submit your resume together with a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and suitability for the position.

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

result.description:
We are looking for an experienced and driven ICT Project Manager to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of technology projects across our organisation. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership capabilities, a solid understanding of ICT systems and infrastructure, and a proven ability to manage competing priorities within budget and timeline constraints. This role suits a results-oriented professional who thrives in dynamic environments and can effectively bridge technical and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Plan, organise, and oversee end-to-end delivery of ICT projects, ensuring milestones, objectives, and deliverables are met within agreed timeframes and budgets
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to address those requirements effectively
Formulate and contribute to ICT strategies, policies, and plans that align with broader business goals and digital transformation initiatives
Direct the selection, procurement, and installation of ICT resources, including software, hardware, and infrastructure, and coordinate relevant user training programmes
Manage project resources, scheduling, and task prioritisation, allocating team members and contractors to maximise efficiency and project outcomes
Set priorities across system development, maintenance, and operational activities, balancing short-term demands with long-term strategic objectives
Oversee the security and integrity of ICT systems, ensuring compliance with organisational policies, data governance frameworks, and relevant legislative requirements
Identify, assess, and manage project risks and issues, implementing mitigation strategies and escalating where necessary to ensure continuity of delivery
Develop and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, status reports, risk registers, and post-implementation reviews
Liaise with internal stakeholders, vendors, and third-party service providers to manage expectations, resolve impediments, and maintain clear lines of communication throughout the project lifecycle
Monitor project budgets, track expenditure, and provide regular financial reporting to senior leadership and governance committees
Champion continuous improvement by conducting lessons-learnt reviews and embedding better practices across the project delivery function
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Project Management, or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience (typically 3–5 years) managing ICT projects of varying scale and complexity within a corporate or government environment
Proficiency in project management methodologies such as PMBOK, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum frameworks
Strong understanding of ICT infrastructure, software development lifecycles, systems integration, and enterprise technology environments
Proven ability to manage budgets, resource plans, and project schedules using tools such as MS Project, Jira, or equivalent platforms
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
Sound analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to risk and issue management
Experience preparing and presenting project governance documentation, business cases, and status reports to senior leadership
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage vendor relationships effectively
Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, data privacy obligations, and relevant Australian regulatory frameworks
Preferred Qualifications
PMP (Project Management Professional) or PRINCE2 Practitioner certification
ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within ITIL-aligned service environments
